# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://plusmag.ro/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fplusmag.ro%2F)

### Comment
> Both AdGuard DNS Default (94.140.14.14) and Family Protection (94.140.14.15)
> return `94.140.14.33` for `plusmag.ro` instead of the real IPs.
> 
> **Steps to reproduce**
> 
>     dig `@94.140.14.14` plusmag.ro   ->  94.140.14.33    (AdGuard block address)
>     dig `@1.1.1.1`      plusmag.ro   ->  104.21.77.175   (real site)
> 
> Verified with `dig` from an external server, with no other blocker,
> VPN or user rule in the path.
> 
> **About the domain**
> 
> plusmag.ro is the e-commerce website of a registered Romanian company
> (PLUS MAG IT SOLUTIONS SRL, CUI 47402357, J10/6/2023) selling IT equipment,
> refurbished computers and video surveillance systems.
> 
> **Every other major filtering resolver resolves it normally**
> 
> | Resolver | Result |
> |---|---|
> | Cloudflare Family (1.1.1.3) | resolves correctly |
> | Quad9 (9.9.9.9) | resolves correctly |
> | CleanBrowsing Security (185.228.168.9) | resolves correctly |
> | OpenDNS (208.67.222.222) | resolves correctly |
> | Comodo Secure (8.26.56.26) | resolves correctly |
> | Neustar Threat (156.154.70.2) | resolves correctly |
> 
> AdGuard is currently the only resolver still blocking this domain.
> Google Safe Browsing reports "No unsafe content found".
> 
> **Likely origin of the flag**
> 
> A PIKABOT association recorded by Cluster25 about two years ago, visible on
> VirusTotal. That infrastructure no longer exists. The site was rebuilt in 2026
> on a new stack (Next.js + Fastify + PostgreSQL) on new servers:
> 
> - no PHP application served; `wp-login.php`, `xmlrpc.php`, `wp-admin` and
>   `.env` all return HTTP 404
> - only ports 80, 443 and 22 exposed
> - no obfuscated JavaScript: no `eval()`, `atob()`, `fromCharCode()`,
>   `document.write()`; no iframes
> - HTTPS enforced site-wide, HSTS with preload
> - payments handled entirely by Revolut Business; no card data stored
> 
> Other domains owned by the same company (plusit.ro, pluswebsite.ro,
> plusfirme.ro) are **not** blocked, which is consistent with a stale historical
> flag on this one domain rather than a property of the current infrastructure.
> 
> Real customers are prevented from reaching a legitimate business. Please
> re-evaluate. Company registration documents can be provided on request.



### Screenshots
<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/l0qiml46y28sck040cgo00kw4wsgcg49e5mp49nigo.jpg?nc=1)
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1 with AdGuard disabled</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/t5282ugp7esgogkooscs8kwg0okg4wk83jcyasthz4.jpg?nc=1)
</details>

### System configuration

| Information | Value |
|-------------|-------|
AdGuard product: | AdGuard DNS
DNS setup: | Router
DNS server: | Default
System version: | `Windows 11`
Browser: | Chrome

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://plusmag.ro/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fplusmag.ro%2F)

### Comment
> Both AdGuard DNS Default (94.140.14.14) and Family Protection (94.140.14.15)
> return `94.140.14.33` for `plusmag.ro` instead of the real IPs.
> 
> **Steps to reproduce**
> 
>     dig `@94.140.14.14` plusmag.ro   ->  94.140.14.33    (AdGuard block address)
>     dig `@1.1.1.1`      plusmag.ro   ->  104.21.77.175   (real site)
> 
> Verified with `dig` from an external server, with no other blocker,
> VPN or user rule in the path.
> 
> **About the domain**
> 
> plusmag.ro is the e-commerce website of a registered Romanian company
> (PLUS MAG IT SOLUTIONS SRL, CUI 47402357, J10/6/2023) selling IT equipment,
> refurbished computers and video surveillance systems.
> 
> **Every other major filtering resolver resolves it normally**
> 
> | Resolver | Result |
> |---|---|
> | Cloudflare Family (1.1.1.3) | resolves correctly |
> | Quad9 (9.9.9.9) | resolves correctly |
> | CleanBrowsing Security (185.228.168.9) | resolves correctly |
> | OpenDNS (208.67.222.222) | resolves correctly |
> | Comodo Secure (8.26.56.26) | resolves correctly |
> | Neustar Threat (156.154.70.2) | resolves correctly |
> 
> AdGuard is currently the only resolver still blocking this domain.
> Google Safe Browsing reports "No unsafe content found".
> 
> **Likely origin of the flag**
> 
> A PIKABOT association recorded by Cluster25 about two years ago, visible on
> VirusTotal. That infrastructure no longer exists. The site was rebuilt in 2026
> on a new stack (Next.js + Fastify + PostgreSQL) on new servers:
> 
> - no PHP application served; `wp-login.php`, `xmlrpc.php`, `wp-admin` and
>   `.env` all return HTTP 404
> - only ports 80, 443 and 22 exposed
> - no obfuscated JavaScript: no `eval()`, `atob()`, `fromCharCode()`,
>   `document.write()`; no iframes
> - HTTPS enforced site-wide, HSTS with preload
> - payments handled entirely by Revolut Business; no card data stored
> 
> Other domains owned by the same company (plusit.ro, pluswebsite.ro,
> plusfirme.ro) are **not** blocked, which is consistent with a stale historical
> flag on this one domain rather than a property of the current infrastructure.
> 
> Real customers are prevented from reaching a legitimate business. Please
> re-evaluate. Company registration documents can be provided on request.



### Screenshots
<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/l0qiml46y28sck040cgo00kw4wsgcg49e5mp49nigo.jpg?nc=1)
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1 with AdGuard disabled</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/t5282ugp7esgogkooscs8kwg0okg4wk83jcyasthz4.jpg?nc=1)
</details>

### System configuration

| Information | Value |
|-------------|-------|
AdGuard product: | AdGuard DNS
DNS setup: | Router
DNS server: | Default
System version: | `Windows 11`
Browser: | Chrome

[https://plusmag.ro/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fplusmag.ro%2F)

### Comment
> Both AdGuard DNS Default (94.140.14.14) and Family Protection (94.140.14.15)
> return `94.140.14.33` for `plusmag.ro` instead of the real IPs.
> 
> **Steps to reproduce**

>     dig `@1.1.1.1`      plusmag.ro   ->  104.21.77.175   (real site)
> 
> Verified with `dig` from an external server, with no other blocker,
> VPN or user rule in the path.
> 
> **About the domain**
> 
> plusmag.ro is the e-commerce website of a registered Romanian company
> (PLUS MAG IT SOLUTIONS SRL, CUI 47402357, J10/6/2023) selling IT equipment,
> refurbished computers and video surveillance systems.
> 
> **Every other major filtering resolver resolves it normally**
> 
> | Resolver | Result |
> |---|---|
> | Cloudflare Family (1.1.1.3) | resolves correctly |
> | Quad9 (9.9.9.9) | resolves correctly |
> | CleanBrowsing Security (185.228.168.9) | resolves correctly |
> | OpenDNS (208.67.222.222) | resolves correctly |
> | Comodo Secure (8.26.56.26) | resolves correctly |
> | Neustar Threat (156.154.70.2) | resolves correctly |
> 
> AdGuard is currently the only resolver still blocking this domain.
> Google Safe Browsing reports "No unsafe content found".
> 
> **Likely origin of the flag**
> 
> A PIKABOT association recorded by Cluster25 about two years ago, visible on
> VirusTotal. That infrastructure no longer exists. The site was rebuilt in 2026
> on a new stack (Next.js + Fastify + PostgreSQL) on new servers:
> 
> - no PHP application served; `wp-login.php`, `xmlrpc.php`, `wp-admin` and
>   `.env` all return HTTP 404
> - only ports 80, 443 and 22 exposed
> - no obfuscated JavaScript: no `eval()`, `atob()`, `fromCharCode()`,
>   `document.write()`; no iframes
> - HTTPS enforced site-wide, HSTS with preload
> - payments handled entirely by Revolut Business; no card data stored
> 
> Other domains owned by the same company (plusit.ro, pluswebsite.ro,
> plusfirme.ro) are **not** blocked, which is consistent with a stale historical
> flag on this one domain rather than a property of the current infrastructure.
> 
> Real customers are prevented from reaching a legitimate business. Please
> re-evaluate. Company registration documents can be provided on request.

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://play.hbomax.com/video/watch-sport/7b2a25cc-b973-540f-aa45-1ee93d6644df/6bacd0aa-71c6-4626-a9a4-64c72b09ee2d](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fplay.hbomax.com%2Fvideo%2Fwatch-sport%2F7b2a25cc-b973-540f-aa45-1ee93d6644df%2F6bacd0aa-71c6-4626-a9a4-64c72b09ee2d) ### Comment > The following rule breaks rewinding on live streams: > > ``` > play.discoveryplus.com,play.hbomax.com#%#//scriptlet('xml-prune', 'xpath(//*[name()="MPD"]/@mediaPresentationDuration | //*[name()="Period"]/@start | //*[name()="Period"][not(.//*[name()="SegmentTimeline"] or .//*[name()="ContentProtection"])] | //*[name()="Period"][./*[name()="BaseURL"]][not(.//*[name()="ContentProtection"])])', '', '.mpd') > ``` > > Unlike VODs, live streams start with a `<Period start=` that is not 0, so stripping that breaks the scrub bar. > > Live streams don't really have "inserted" ads (they have natural ads as a part of the TV channel's live broadcast output), so might be worth checking for `MPD@type`: https://dashif.org/Guidelines-TimingModel/#timing-and-presentation-types (live streams have `dynamic` while VODs have `static`) ### Screenshots

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).
